## ⬇️ Which file do I download?

| File | When to pick it |
|---|---|
| **`Vantage-Setup.exe`** | ⭐ **Most people.** Double-click to install per-user (no admin prompt). Start Menu shortcut included. |
| `Vantage-{VERSION}-win-x64-portable.zip` | No-install option: unzip anywhere, run `Vantage.exe`. Fully self-contained. |
| `Vantage-{VERSION}-win-x64-lite.zip` | Tiny download if you already have the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0). |
| `checksums.txt` | SHA-256 hashes of every file above. |

> **SmartScreen note:** binaries are not yet code-signed, so Windows may warn on first run — click **More info → Run anyway**, and verify the SHA-256 against `checksums.txt` if in doubt.

**Requirements:** Windows 10 20H2+ / Windows 11 (recommended), x64, no admin rights needed.
Full documentation: [README](https://github.com/inakizamores/vantagedisplaymanager#readme) · [Changelog](https://github.com/inakizamores/vantagedisplaymanager/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
